name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Ham, Bell Pepper, Zucchini & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g fettuccine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; add to the bowl.
Small dice ham and add to the bowl with the veggies.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and ham; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are soft, add parsley, Alfredo sauce, and spices to the pot; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is warmed through, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (454 g) jars alfredo sauce
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer drained pasta to the pot with the sauce and toss to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
